correctness.rationale: The exact BH two-test rejection partition gives FDR=P(U<=alpha/2,V>alpha)+0.5 P(U<=alpha,V<=alpha)=alpha/2+0.5[P(alpha/2<U<=alpha,V<=alpha)-P(U<=alpha/2,V<=alpha)] <=3alpha/4 for U uniform. Set mu=-Phi^-1(alpha/2)-Phi^-1(alpha)>0, with Y1=-Z,Y2=Z+mu at rho=-1; V<=alpha iff U>=alpha/2, making the FDR exactly 3alpha/4. The corresponding rho>-1 positive-definite normal laws converge almost surely in threshold indicators, so the supremum holds for nonsingular rho<0. At alpha=1/20 and rho=-99999999/100000000, coupling with boundary normal yields P(alternative threshold changes)<epsilon+2*10^-8/epsilon^2=29/5000 for epsilon=1/200; hence FDR>=317/10000. The originating conjecture in Chi et al Section 7 is FDR<=tilde_s_2(alpha)/2; Eq.(26) bounded by e<3 and pi>2 gives <30307/1088000. Exact independent rational arithmetic verified strict gap; neither numerical integration nor singular covariance is used as the final counterexample.
